purpose: Teach: 送別/追従/面識/外形/技巧/乗組/パネリスト/不買

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、退職者の送別会を丁寧に開け
lines.en: I want us to host the retirement send-off with proper ceremony.
lines.style: Clear, measured direction. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who expects competent execution, not debate. Slight pause before the instruction lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。盲目的な追従ではなく独自路線で進めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll move forward with our own approach, not just follow what's expected.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation with undertone of capability. Measured pace, attentive posture. Shows he's already thinking ahead—not just receiving orders but accepting responsibility for the execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、面識のない方とも交流の場を作れ
lines.en: And create opportunities for people in the company to connect with those outside our usual circle.
lines.style: Second directive, same authority as the first. Calm, unhurried. The implication that this is part of a larger vision, delivered without dramatizing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の外形特徴も整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also organize the product specifications and external features clearly.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. He's already building the plan in real time—no hesitation, no over-explaining. Quiet competence showing through his brevity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、職人の技巧を継承しろ
lines.en: Preserve the craftspeople's techniques and pass that knowledge forward.
lines.style: Third direction. Voice slightly more weighted—this one matters more. Not louder, but with the gravity of someone speaking about tradition and continuity. Measured breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。タンカーの乗組員配置を見直します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review the crew assignments for the tanker operations as well.
lines.style: Acceptance without question. Demonstrates he can hold multiple priorities at once without becoming scattered. Still present, still reliable—not rushing to close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 講演会のパネリストに当社の専門家を出せ
lines.en: Get one of our specialists on the panel for the lecture series.
lines.style: Fourth directive, slightly more direct. Shorter phrasing. Still composed but with the efficiency of someone moving through a list he's already worked out. No wasted words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不買運動の動向を注視します
lines.en: Yes. I'll monitor the boycott movement and keep watch on any developments.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slower pace—showing he understands the gravity of this last item. Alert but calm. The note of someone who recognizes potential risk and is ready to track it.
